pain.advice: Siyalicebisa ukuthi lixhumane lodokotela wenu lingakazivocavoci lamuhla.
pain.red_flags: Kukhona ukuvuvuka, ubundikindiki loba ubuhlungu obubukhali na?
home.offline_notice: Kasiyifinyeleli iseva khathesi. Lingaqhubeka lizivocavoca — okwenzayo kugcinwa kule foni kuthunyelwe ngemva.
home.no_program: Akukho zivocavoco elizinikiweyo. Khethani esinye ezivocavocweni ezingezansi.
cg.title: Ukusiza isiguli
cg.helping: Lisiza {name} ukuzivocavoca. Ilizwi lizakhuluma lani, msizi.
cg.setup1_body: Liyiseke entweni eqinileyo, ikhamera ikhangele umuntu.
cg.setup3_title: Qinisekisani ukuthi umzimba wabo wonke uyabonakala
cg.setup3_body: Kusukela ekhanda kuze kube senyaweni esikrinini. I-app izalitshela nxa kungenjalo.
cg.no_program: Akukho zivocavoco abazinikiweyo. Khethani esinye ezivocavocweni ezingezansi.
mirror.portrait_hint: Phendulani ifoni ibe ngecele loba libuyele emuva ukuze umzimba wenu wonke ubonakale.
hud.title: ISIBUKO SOKULULAMA · AI
cam.privacy: Ividiyo yenu ihlala kule foni. Amamaki okuzivocavoca kuphela ayathunyelwa kudokotela wenu.
cam.safety: Yimani nxa lizwa ubuhlungu obubukhali, isiyezi loba ubundikindiki.
cam.safety_cg: Yimani nxa bezwa ubuhlungu obubukhali, isiyezi loba ubundikindiki.
cam.stand_back: Yimani amamitha angu-2–3 ukusuka efonini ukuze umzimba wenu wonke ubonakale.
cam.stand_back_cg: Bamiseni amamitha angu-2–3 ukusuka efonini ukuze umzimba wabo wonke ubonakale.
cam.denied_body: I-RecoverLens idinga ikhamera ukuze ibone ukunyakaza kwenu. Ukuyivumela:
cam.denied_chrome: Chrome / Android: thintani ilokhi loba uphawu lwekhamera endaweni yekheli → Permissions → Camera → Allow.
cam.denied_safari: Safari / iPhone: thintani “aA” endaweni yekheli → Website Settings → Camera → Allow.
cam.notfound_body: Xhumani ikhamera, loba livule i-RecoverLens efonini, beselizama futhi.
cam.insecure_body: Amabrawuza avumela ikhamera emakhasini e-https:// kuphela (loba i-localhost). Sebenzisani ilinki ye-HTTPS.
cam.error_body: Valani amanye ama-app okungenzeka ukuthi asebenzisa ikhamera, beselizama futhi.
sum.title: KUPHELILE
share.title: Ukuzivocavoca nge-RecoverLens
rec.torso_lean: Gcinani umzimba uqondile. Zamani ukwenza lokhu limi umhlane useduze komduli.
rec.asymmetry: Yenzani kancane ukuze amacele womabili anyakaze ndawonye.
rec.elbow_bend: Gcinani izindololwane ziqondile kukho konke ukunyakaza.
rec.back_arch: Qinisani imisipha yesisu ukuze umhlane ungagobi.
rec.heel_rise: Gcinani izithende phansi; izivocavoco zokwelula inyawo zingasiza.
rec.pelvis_drop: Gcinani izinqulu zilingana; ukuqinisa izinqulu kungasiza.
rec.not_high_enough: Sebenzelani ukufika kude ngokukwazi kwenu, lingezwa buhlungu.
guided.explain: Ikhamera eyodwa kayikwazi ukulinganisa lokhu kunyakaza kahle, ngakho i-RecoverLens ilikhokhela ngesikhathi.
sports.title: Ukuhlolwa kwabadlali
sports.intro: Ukuhlola okufitshane kokunyakaza. Okutholakalayo kungokuhlolwa ngumqeqeshi loba udokotela, akusikho ukuhlolwa kwesifo.
sports.none_hint: Yenzani ukuhlola ukuze libone okutholakeleyo lapha.
screen.title: Ukuhlolwa {i}/{n} · {label}
screen.note: Lokhu kubonwe yikhamera, akusikho ukuhlolwa kwesifo. Kugcinwe ngokuzenzakalela.

obs.squat_torso.bad: Umzimba watsheka ecele ekuphindeni okungu-{n} ku-{total}

obs.sls_valgus_right.bad: Idolo lesokudla langena phakathi ekugobeni okungu-{n} ku-{total} ngomlenze owodwa
obs.sls_pelvis_left.bad: Izinqulu zehla ekugobeni okungu-{n} ku-{total} ngomlenze wesokhohlo
obs.sls_pelvis_right.bad: Izinqulu zehla ekugobeni okungu-{n} ku-{total} ngomlenze wesokudla

obs.balance_right.bad: Akuphelelanga ukubamba imizuzwana engu-{seconds} ngomlenze wesokudla

obs.landing_valgus.bad: Amadolo angena phakathi ekwehleni okungu-{n} ku-{total}
obsrec.valgus: Cabangani ngokuqinisa imisipha yenqulu lezinqe (isibonelo izivocavoco ze-FIFA 11+ zokuma ngomlenze owodwa lokugoba amadolo).
obsrec.lean: Cabangani ngezivocavoco zokunyakazisa amaqakala lokuqinisa isisu lomhlane (isibonelo FIFA 11+ Bench/Sideways Bench).
obsrec.asymmetry: Cabangani ngokulinganisa amandla omlenze ngamunye lokuziqeqesha ukuma ngomlenze owodwa (FIFA 11+ Single-Leg Stance).
obsrec.heel: Cabangani ngezivocavoco zokwelula imilenze lamaqakala lingakaqalisi ukweqa.
obsrec.fifa_valgus: FIFA 11+: Squats (With Toe Raise → One-Leg Squats) le-Single-Leg Stance.
obsrec.fifa_landing: FIFA 11+: Jumping (Vertical Jumps), lisehla kancane amadolo ekhangele amazwane.

clin.server_error: Kasiyifinyelelanga iseva. Hlolani ukuxhumana beselizama futhi.
alert.score_drop: Amamaki okunyakaza ehlile esuka ku-{from} esiya ku-{to}.
alert.pain: Ubuhlungu benyukele ku-{pain}/10 uma kuqhathaniswa lezikhathi zakuqala.
alert.no_session_new: Akukho kuzivocavoca selokhu bangezwa, insuku ezingu-{days} ezedlulileyo.
pd.trends_hint: Inqubekela phambili izabonakala ngemva kokuzivocavoca kokuqala.
ex.shoulder_abduction.name: Ukuphakamisa izingalo eceleni
ex.shoulder_abduction.desc: Phakamisani izingalo zombili eceleni kuze kufike emahlombe, umzimba uqondile.
ex.shoulder_abduction.step2: Phakamisani izingalo zombili eceleni kuze kufike emahlombe.
ex.shoulder_flexion.name: Ukuphakamisa ingalo phambili
ex.shoulder_flexion.desc: Yimani ngehlangothi likhangele ikhamera liphakamise ingalo phambili laphezulu, lingagobi umhlane.
ex.shoulder_flexion.step1: Phendukani ngehlangothi likhangele ikhamera, ingalo eceleni.
ex.shoulder_flexion.step2: Phakamisani ingalo phambili laphezulu ngokukwazi kwenu lingezwa buhlungu.
ex.shoulder_flexion.step3: Ehlisani kancane kancane. Gcinani umhlane uqondile.
ex.shoulder_external_rotation.name: Ukuphendula ingalo ngaphandle
ex.shoulder_external_rotation.desc: Indololwane inamathele eceleni igobe njengekona, phendulani ingalo ngaphandle.
ex.shoulder_internal_rotation.name: Ukuphendula ingalo ngakusisu
ex.shoulder_internal_rotation.desc: Indololwane inamathele eceleni igobe njengekona, phendulani ingalo ngakusisu.
ex.pendulum_swing.name: Ukuphendulisa ingalo elengayo
ex.pendulum_swing.desc: Encikani etafuleni, ingalo ilenge ikhululekile, iphenduliswe ngemijikelezo emincane.
ex.mini_squat.name: Ukugoba amadolo kancane
ex.mini_squat.desc: Inyawo zehlukene ngobubanzi bezinqulu, gobani amadolo kancane, beselisukuma.
ex.mini_squat.step1: Khangelani ikhamera, inyawo zehlukene ngobubanzi bezinqulu.
ex.sit_to_stand.name: Ukusukuma esihlalweni
ex.sit_to_stand.desc: Hlalani ngehlangothi likhangele ikhamera, beselisukuma ngokugcweleyo lihlale phansi ngokucophelela.
ex.sit_to_stand.step1: Bekani isihlalo esiqinileyo ngehlangothi likhangele ikhamera lihlale phansi.
ex.sit_to_stand.step2: Sukumani ngokugcweleyo lingasebenzisi izandla nxa lingakwenza.
ex.single_leg_balance.name: Ukuma ngomlenze owodwa
ex.single_leg_balance.desc: Yimani ngomlenze owodwa imizuzwana engu-30, izinqulu zilingana.
ex.single_leg_balance.step1: Khangelani ikhamera, limi eduze komduli loba isihlalo ukuze lisekelwe.
ex.quad_set.name: Ukuqinisa ithanga
ex.quad_set.desc: Qondisani idolo liqinise ithanga lingaphakamisi umlenze.
ex.quad_set.step2: Cindezelani ingemuva ledolo phansi liqinise ithanga.
ex.straight_leg_raise.name: Ukuphakamisa umlenze oqondileyo
ex.straight_leg_raise.desc: Lilele phansi, gcinani idolo liqondile liphakamisa lehlisa kancane kancane.
ex.straight_leg_raise.step2: Qinisani ithanga liphakamise umlenze oqondileyo kuze kufike ekuphakameni kwelinye idolo.
ex.heel_slide.name: Ukuhudula isithende
ex.heel_slide.desc: Lilele phansi, hudulani isithende kini ukuze idolo ligobe, beseliqondisa.
ex.step_up.name: Ukukhwela isitebhisi
ex.step_up.desc: Khweleni esitebhisini esiphansi, liqala ngomlenze osesilulama.
ex.step_up.step2: Khweleni ngomlenze osesilulama, beselikhwelisa olunye unyawo.
ex.squat_screen.name: Ukuhlolwa kokugoba amadolo
ex.squat_screen.step1: Khangelani ikhamera, inyawo zehlukene ngobubanzi bamahlombe, izingalo phambili.
ex.squat_screen.step2: Gobani amadolo, lehle ngokukwazi kwenu lingezwa buhlungu.
ex.single_leg_squat.name: Ukugoba idolo ngomlenze owodwa
ex.single_leg_squat.desc: Ukugoba idolo kancane kahlanu limi ngomlenze owodwa.
ex.single_leg_squat.step2: Gobani idolo elimeyo kancane, likhangele amazwane.
ex.jump_landing.name: Ukweqa lokwehla phansi
ex.jump_landing.desc: Ukweqa phezulu kathathu, lisehla kancane ngezinyawo zombili.
ex.jump_landing.step1: Khangelani ikhamera kulendawo eyaneleyo eceleni kwenu.
ex.jump_landing.step3: Ehlani kancane amadolo egobile. Yenzani kathathu.
a11y.voice_note: Ilizwi libala yonke imilayo ngokuzwakalayo, ngakho lingalandela lingakhangeli esikrinini.

ins.title: Okubonwe ngumqeqeshi
ins.subtitle: Kubalwe kule fonini kusukela ekuzivocavoceni okwenziweyo. Lokhu ngokubonwayo, hatshi ukuhlolwa kwesifo.

ins.score_down: Amamaki okunyakaza ehle ngamamaki angu-{n} ekuzivocavoceni okungu-{count} kokucina.
ins.range_up: {exercise}: ilunga linyakaze {n}° ngaphezu kokuzivocavoca okungu-{count} okwedlulileyo.
ins.range_down: {exercise}: ilunga linyakaze {n}° ngaphansi kokuzivocavoca okungu-{count} okwedlulileyo.
ins.days: Ukuzivocavoca kwenziwe ngensuku ezingu-{n} kwezingu-7 ezedlulileyo.

ins.fatigue_steady: Ukuphinda kuhlale kuzinzile ekuzivocavoceni okungu-{count} kokucina.

fatigue.tip: Amasethi amafitshane kumbe ukuphumula okude kungasiza.
base.caption: "Okujwayelekileyo" yisilinganiso sokuzivocavoca okufika ku-3 okwedlulileyo kwalesi sivocavoco.
base.first: Ukuzivocavoca kokuqala kwalesi sivocavoco okubhaliweyo. Kuzakuba yisilinganiso sesikhathi esilandelayo.
